'''Sand-repelling capsules''' were devices worn around the neck by some tribes of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], a nomadic [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Some clans, including the [[Rrhr hunting band]], did not wear them, favoring simple scarves instead.<ref name="AOTCV" /> The tribe of [[URoRRuR'R'R]] and [[RR'uruurrr]], however, did sport those sand-repelling devices.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
